visual_logic: Showcases the iconic, long, completely toothless spear-like jaw profile of Pteranodon using the wide open split perspective.
prompt: High-fidelity 3D asset of the open, toothless jaws of a Pteranodon, viewed from a direct three quarter view perspective, rendered in a 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized edges. The long, elegant, dagger-like jaws open wide around a hollow central cavity. The margins are perfectly smooth and covered in a beautiful matte yellow-orange keratin sheath. At the base of the long jaw hinges, the stylized head features smooth, dark navy-blue skin and large, warm, highly expressive character eyes looking up. The entire specimen is centered in a 1:1 square composition, maintaining a strict 25% negative space safety margin. Placed flat against a neutral, 50% grey studio floor plane with soft contact shadows. Illuminated by balanced studio lighting.
